changes.note: `max_completion_tokens` also counts the reasoning tokens these models spend before they answer, so the same limit can leave a shorter answer, or an empty one when the limit is small. Raise it if answers come back cut off.

changes.note: The model now samples with its own defaults, so answers can be more or less varied than with the value the code set. Guide tone and format in the prompt instead.

changes.quote: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna support function calling in Chat Completions only with `reasoning_effort: "none"`. Use Responses for reasoning with tools.
changes.note: OpenAI's GPT-6 guide says these models call functions in Chat Completions only with `reasoning_effort: "none"`, and to use the Responses API for reasoning with tools. Choosing between them changes how the model reasons or how the request and response are written, so Refit leaves it to you.

Moving to `tools` and `tool_choice` also changes the response: calls come back in `message.tool_calls` with an ID each, not `message.function_call`, and each result goes back as a `tool` message with that ID. Code that reads the response has to change with the request, so Refit does not rewrite it.
